newsitem.title: CANADA: Barrick no comment on Great Central rumour.
newsitem.headline: Barrick no comment on Great Central rumour.

text.p: Canada's Barrick Gold Corp on Tuesday declined to comment on reports that it was expected to launch a takeover bid for Australia's Great Central Mines Ltd.
"Our policy is not to comment on any rumors or speculation in the marketplace -- in Australia or Canada," Barrick spokesman Vince Borg said in a telephone interview.
The Australian Financial Review newspaper said earlier in a report that Barrick was expected to make a bid within days.
"Barrick is known to have had a team of executives in Australia casting their eyes over the Great Central assets," the Financial Review said in its Chanticleer column.
Borg could not confirm whether Barrick executives had visited Australia recently.
The newspaper said any takeover bid would value Great Central at close to A$700 million.
Great Central's current resource estimate is 6.3 million ounces of gold while proved and probable reserves totalled 2.6 million ounces.
